title: Source of True Knowledge
summary: God is the efficient cause of all true knowledge and all that is known through knowledge.
summaryHi: सब सत्यविद्या और जो पदार्थ विद्या से जाने जाते हैं, उन सबका आदिमूल परमेश्वर है।
detail: The first principle anchors all inquiry in one formless, omniscient, and just Creator—free from idol worship and superstition.

title: Nature of Ishwara
summary: God is existent, intelligent, and blissful; formless, almighty, just, merciful, unborn, and worthy of worship.
summaryHi: ईश्वर सच्चिदानन्दस्वरूप, निराकार, सर्वशक्तिमान, न्यायकारी, दयालु, अजन्मा, अनन्त, निर्विकार और सर्वव्यापक है।
detail: Devotion in Arya Samaj is direct communion through Sandhya, contemplation, and righteous living rather than ritualized intermediaries.

title: Authority of the Vedas
summary: The Vedas are the scriptures of all true knowledge; it is the paramount duty of every Arya to read and teach them.
summaryHi: वेद सब सत्यविद्याओं का पुस्तक है। वेद का पढ़ना-पढ़ाना और सुनना-सुनाना सब आर्यों का परम धर्म है।
detail: Vedic study is open to every human being—across gender, birth, and nation—encouraging reasoned understanding over blind repetition.

title: Embrace Truth, Renounce Untruth
summary: One should always be ready to accept truth and to renounce untruth.
summaryHi: सत्य के ग्रहण करने और असत्य के छोड़ने में सर्वदा उद्यत रहना चाहिए।
detail: Intellectual honesty requires testing every belief against evidence, logic, and Vedic ethics.

title: Dharma in Every Action
summary: All acts ought to be performed in accordance with Dharma—after deliberating what is right and wrong.
summaryHi: सब काम धर्मानुसार अर्थात सत्य और असत्य को विचार करके करने चाहिए।
detail: Ethics precede convenience; every personal and public choice is weighed on the scale of truth and justice.

title: Good of the Whole World
summary: The primary object of Arya Samaj is to do good to the whole world—improving physical, spiritual, and social conditions.
summaryHi: संसार का उपकार करना इस समाज का मुख्य उद्देश्य है अर्थात शारीरिक, आत्मिक और सामाजिक उन्नति करना।
detail: True spirituality expresses itself in health, education, social harmony, and care for all creation.

title: Love, Righteousness & Justice
summary: Our conduct towards all ought to be guided by love, righteousness, and justice.
summaryHi: सबसे प्रीतिपूर्वक, धर्मानुसार और यथायोग्य वर्तना चाहिए।
detail: Compassion is paired with fairness—honoring the dignity of every individual without prejudice.

title: Dispel Ignorance, Promote Vidya
titleHi: अविद्या का नाश, विद्या की वृद्धि
summary: We should dispel ignorance (Avidya) and promote true knowledge (Vidya).
summaryHi: अविद्या का नाश और विद्या की वृद्धि करनी चाहिए।
detail: This principle inspired hundreds of Gurukuls, schools, and colleges empowering boys and girls alike.

title: Collective Upliftment
summary: No one should remain content with only their own upliftment, but see their own good in the good of all.
summaryHi: प्रत्येक को अपनी ही उन्नति से संतुष्ट न रहना चाहिए, किंतु सबकी उन्नति में अपनी उन्नति समझनी चाहिए।
detail: Personal prosperity is incomplete unless it strengthens the wellbeing of the wider community.

title: Social Harmony & Conscience
summary: Everyone should abide by rules made for the general wellbeing of society, while remaining free in personal wellbeing.
summaryHi: सब मनुष्यों को सामाजिक सर्वहितकारी नियम पालने में परतंत्र रहना चाहिए और प्रत्येक हितकारी नियम में सब स्वतंत्र रहें।
detail: Balances civic responsibility for the common good with individual freedom of conscience.
